messages:
Nora (FinOps): FYI caught ~74 invoices in the nightly reconciliation with zero usage/proration lines. NetSuite export included them as $0 line-only invoices. Looks linked to webhooks failing verification overnight.

Diego (Payments Eng): That's bad. Any error samples? Could this be related to last night's signing secret rotation we ran?

Nora (FinOps): Yep timing matches. Rotation started 2026-03-25T02:00 UTC. Example log: 
```
2026-03-25T02:07:03Z WARN webhook-verify requestId=abcd sig_check=failed signature=old_sig reason=missing-sig-v1
2026-03-25T02:07:03Z INFO webhook-retry enqueued event=evt_3 retry=1
2026-03-25T02:07:20Z ERROR invoice-aggregator invoice=inv_02Jk9Z1P missing_usage_lines
```
Most of these events never made it into the normal apply path because our verification layer simply dropped them instead of routing to DLQ.

Priya (Billing Ops): I noticed the NetSuite push marked ~70 invoices as "no lines" which then caused our load-based validation to skip posting. I paused the downstream batch job for the 02:00-02:30 window. Please don't create manual credits.

deploy-bot: Deploy payment-secret-rotation v1.2 started at 2026-03-25T01:58:00Z; target: webhook-consumer-prod (3 replicas).

Diego (Payments Eng): Root cause: rotation job removed support for the previous secret for ~9m while the roll completed. Our verifier returns 401 and we had a silent drop on verification error (legacy behavior). I'll push hotfix to (payments/webhook-consumer#459) to: (1) accept both old and new secrets during rotation window, (2) route unverifiable events to DLQ instead of dropping, (3) add metric webhook.verify.failures. PR up, requesting urgent review.

Nora (FinOps): Good. For remediation we need: (A) replay missed events into apply pipeline, with idempotency checks; (B) NetSuite re-export of corrected invoices; (C) a customer-facing note if any customers saw incorrect invoice PDFs.

Priya (Billing Ops): I'll create a NetSuite re-export job for the window and hold off posting until replay confirms lines present. Also adding a validation step to the export that fails the job if invoice.lines_count == 0 for paid/posted invoices.

Diego (Payments Eng): Replay plan: use dlq-replayer to pull events labeled "verification-drop" between 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z and 2026-03-25T02:10:00Z. We will run: 
```bash
# dry-run first
./bin/dlq-replay --tag verification-drop --since 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z --to 2026-03-25T02:10:00Z --dry-run --log-level=info
# live run after dry-run ok
./bin/dlq-replay --tag verification-drop --since 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z --to 2026-03-25T02:10:00Z --dedupe --checksum-compare
```
I'll also add a safety flag to skip any invoice that's marked as posted_to_netsuite=true to avoid double-posts.

Nora (FinOps): I can produce the list of affected invoice IDs and a mapping to customer emails. Putting export at gs://redwood-finance/backfills/2026-03-25-rot-missed.csv. Will coordinate with CS once we confirm which invoices were actually charged incorrectly.

integrations-bot: Alert: DLQ size spike detected at 2026-03-25T02:10:05Z, tag=verification-drop, count=82. Ticket INC-2026-3421 opened.

Priya (Billing Ops): Heads-up: some of these invoices are on scheduled payment attempts. If we replay and add lines after a payment succeeded, we might need to trigger adjustments. I'll flag invoices with payment_attempted=true for manual review.

Diego (Payments Eng): Noted. We'll include a "post-payment-policy=manual_review" behavior for replayed events on invoices with payment_attempted=true. Also adding an automated check to block NetSuite export for any invoice where checksum_before != checksum_after without a manual review tag.

Nora (FinOps): Proposed next steps and owners: Diego - hotfix + deploy, run DLQ dry-run, then replay; Priya - hold NetSuite export and prepare re-export; Nora - compile invoice list and coordinate CS comms; Diego - own postmortem. ETA for cleanup: 6-8 hours pending dry-run success.

Diego (Payments Eng): Hotfix merged, deploying now. Will post dry-run results in ~30m.

Priya (Billing Ops): I'll set the export job to manual and notify accounting to expect re-export.

Nora (FinOps): Thanks team. After replay we'll reconcile revenue reports for the day and confirm no double-charges. Add this incident to the finance retro and include a note to avoid silent-drop behavior in any verification path.
